text:
rachel: Morning — after the partner push yesterday dashboards show big session lift but MQLs flat. Patterns look different vs previous launches. can we validate partner tagging?
omar: I pulled the partner click logs: partner passes `ref=partnerX` on links instead of utm_source. GA4 mapping doesn't pick that up so these end up as 'unattributed'.
tia: Ugh. Partner docs said they'd include UTMs. Did we have a post-check in the launch checklist?
ben: Not for partner-specific params. Quick check SQL I ran:
```
select count(*) filter (where utm_source is null and url like '%ref=%') as partner_ref_only, count(*) as total
from sessions
where occurred_at >= '2026-03-22'
```
partner_ref_only = 3,120 / total = 15,400 (~20%).
rachel: 20% partner-ref-only is big. That explains the attribution tiles showing 'other'. Action needed: 1) map ref -> utm_source in ETL (analytics) 2) backfill sessions where possible 3) add an "attribution_coverage" tile and alert.
omar: I can add a small regex mapper in the enrichment pipeline: if utm_source is null and query contains ref=, set utm_source=ref value. Will PR and run backfill.
tia: Also flag partner team to include utm_source moving forward. I'll ping Partner Ops with the ask and a short snip they can paste.
ops-bot: partner-proxy v2 deployed at 10:47 UTC (sha: 9f7d1) — preserve_query_params=true in canary.
ben: Backfill plan: match raw click logs -> session_id and populate utm fields for ref matches. Rough ETA 4h, job id backfill-32456. Expected recovery ~60-70% of partner_ref_only.
analytics-bot: Note: Added metric attr_coverage = 1 - (unattributed_sessions / total_sessions) to the weekly KPI dashboard. Default alert at attr_coverage < 0.80.
rachel: Perfect. Omar, can you also snapshot the KPI dashboard pre/backfill for the weekly slides? CEO asked for a before/after callout.
omar: Snapshot (pre): https://app.company/dashboards/kpi/snapshots/3245678901_pre.png
ben: Backfill started (job backfill-32456). Partial match after 90m: 1,900 records matched (~61%). Dropping intermediate CSV to /reports/partner_backfill/partial_3245678901.csv.
tia: I posted a short template to Partner Ops: "Please include utm_source and utm_medium on campaign links (shortlinks are ok if they preserve query params)." Will follow up via email.
ops-bot: partner-proxy hotfix PR: https://git.company/proxy/pull/621 026 merged to main and rolled.
ben: Backfill complete: matched 2,150 of 3,120 (~69%). Adjusted MQL conversion +2.1pp. Snapshot (post): https://app.company/dashboards/kpi/snapshots/3245678901_post.png
rachel: Great recovery. We'll call out the tracking gap and the fix in Monday's KPI deck. Also add a quick item to the launch playbook: "validate partner query params map to UTMs".
omar: Adding playbook item now. Also set an alert to notify #marketing + #eng-oncall if attr_coverage drops below 75% for >1h.
analytics-bot: Alert rule created: marketing.attr_coverage < 0.75 (notify #marketing, #eng-oncall).
tia: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single record. If partner links still appear with ref= on next campaign, escalate to Partner Ops and Eng. :raised_hands:
